source.title: Top 10 dominant species Balayan/Calatagan Bay, Batangas (2018-2022)

posterFile.retrievalMethod: Unauthenticated public HTTPS GET after an ordinary 4-KB range probe; no login, payment, or access-control bypass.

abstractPosterComparison.posterFooterSizeMeaning: Illustrated fish sizes are proportional to each species' maximum length recorded in the area; the size is not a count or abundance measure.

rightsReview.decision: Keep the poster image and all poster-derived species rows out of the public app until item-specific reuse rights, taxonomy, and locality scope are reviewed.

decision: The title/abstract count mismatch is resolved at the source-review level only: the poster labels ten taxa and includes Sardinella lemuru, which the abstract omits. The footer explicitly says the arrangement is not a ranking, so the title does not support abundance ranks.
